_comment: SAM-Road / SpaceNet variant — same model architecture as `sam-road`, but loads spacenet_vitb_256_e10.ckpt (trained at ~0.3 m/px DigitalGlobe imagery, closer to commercial satellite than Cityscale's 1 m/px aerial). PATCH_SIZE=256 and stricter TOPO_THRESHOLD=0.705 are baked into the preset.
